'''Lari Lemmentyinen''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[July 2000 Helsinki tournament]] on 16 July 2000 with [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down IAO]], according to Christoffer Niska's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1009">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-16-the-sauna-helsinki-finland-16-7-2000d1009/ the-sauna-helsinki-finland-16-7-2000], DeckTech (Christoffer "Thedit" Niska, 16 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-16-the-sauna-helsinki-finland-16-7-2000d1009/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
